references.text: The Lord's secret belongs to those who fear him, and his covenant makes them know his will—this relates to the revealed things given to God's people.
It is the glory of God to conceal a matter, but the glory of kings to search out a matter—this concerns the hidden things that belong to God.
God's thoughts and ways are higher than man's, reflecting that the hidden things belong to the Lord.
Paul speaks of the depth of God's riches, wisdom, and knowledge, and that his judgments are unsearchable—this relates to the hidden things that belong to the Lord.
The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God—this shows that God reveals his secrets through the Spirit.
The command to keep the words of the law in your heart and teach them to your children—this relates to the revealed things given to us and our children.
The people and their children shall gather to hear and learn to fear the Lord and keep the words of the law—this concerns doing all the words of this law.
God chooses to reveal his plans to Abraham, who will teach his children to keep the way of the Lord—this concerns revelation given to us and our children.
